finite_check.dgp: stationary Gaussian AR(1), X_t = phi X_{t-1} + eps_t, Var(X_t)=v

quadratic_form_check.form: G_T = X' A X + c, A=0.5*(a a' - I/T + u u'), a=u-phi*e_T, c=0.5*v*(1-phi^2), Sigma_ij=v*phi^|i-j|
quadratic_form_check.interpretation: FW-PT matches an integrated expected bias but cannot recover the realized terminal conditional gap; a conditional method needs an additional transition or calibration component.

finite_check.falsifier: Reject a claimed general conditional-tail method if the finite correction misses exact Delta_T beyond a predeclared tolerance or has worse conditional-target MSE than direct finite-sample predictive criteria on this scalar family. Passing is only an algebraic prerequisite; matching Delta_T alone does not establish terminal conditional validity.

limits: Initial ideas were written before external literature search.
A bounded primary-source search cannot establish global novelty.
No new training, market-data run, or production change was performed.
The scalar check is non-tail and unconditional for Delta_T; terminal conditional r_T is the required next gate.
All final candidate labels remain PROPOSED, BASELINE/CONTROL, or no direct evidence located.
